*** Add File: /mnt/c/Users/cabot/OneDrive/Documents/Research/Cambridge/X3I/mhd_llm/codex/scripts/audit_artifacts.py
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Check integrity, units and geometry; do not turn a failed science test green."""
+from pathlib import Path
+import hashlib, json, subprocess
+import numpy as np
+
+ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+
+def main():
+    checks={};summary=json.loads((ROOT/'results/summary.json').read_text())
+    basis=np.array(json.loads((ROOT/'observations/coordinate_system.json').read_text())['ecliptic_to_solar_equatorial_matrix'])
+    checks['solar_basis_is_rotation']=bool(np.max(abs(basis@basis.T-np.eye(3)))<1e-12 and np.linalg.det(basis)>0.999999)
+    runs={}
+    for folder in sorted((ROOT/'results').iterdir()):
+        if not (folder/'statistics.json').exists():continue
+        csv=folder/'probe.csv'
+        if not csv.exists() or csv.stat().st_size<150:continue
+        a=np.genfromtxt(csv,names=True,delimiter=',')
+        invariant=bool(np.max(abs(a['flux_cm2_s']/(a['n_cm3']*a['speed_kms']*1e5)-1))<1e-9)
+        physical=bool(np.all(a['n_cm3']>0)&np.all(a['p_npa']>0)&np.all(np.isfinite(a['flux_cm2_s'])))
+        runs[folder.name]={'positive_finite_probes':physical,'heliocentric_flux_units_consistent':invariant}
+        for p in folder.glob('snapshot_*.npy'):
+            s=np.load(p,mmap_mode='r')
+            if s.ndim!=4 or s.shape[-1]!=8 or not np.all(s[...,0]>0) or not np.all(s[...,4]>0):
+                raise AssertionError(f'Nonphysical or malformed snapshot {p}')
+    checks['all_completed_probes_physical']=all(r['positive_finite_probes'] for r in runs.values())
+    checks['all_flux_unit_checks_pass']=all(r['heliocentric_flux_units_consistent'] for r in runs.values())
+    c=np.genfromtxt(ROOT/'results/comet_timeseries.csv',names=True,delimiter=',',dtype=None,encoding='utf8')
+    checks['incident_flux_is_lower_for_outbound_comet']=bool(np.all(c['incident_flux_cm2_s']<c['flux_heliocentric_cm2_s']))
+    video=json.loads(subprocess.check_output(['ffprobe','-v','error','-select_streams','v:0','-show_entries','stream=width,height,nb_frames,duration','-of','json',str(ROOT/'figures/solar_wind_topdown.mp4')],text=True))
+    checks['animation_has_multiple_frames']=int(video['streams'][0]['nb_frames'])>=20
+    checks['animation_reaches_beyond2au']=float(np.load(ROOT/'results/medium/r_au.npy')[-1])>2
+    required=['report.html','figures/comet_timeseries.png','figures/density.png','figures/speed.png','figures/flux.png',
+        'figures/solar_wind_topdown.mp4','figures/solar_wind_topdown.gif','figures/solar_wind_flux_contrast.mp4',
+        'validation/inhouse_native.json','validation/manuscript_benchmark.json','external_model/provenance.json',
+        'monitoring/resources.jsonl','monitoring/token_snapshots.jsonl']
+    checks['required_artifacts_exist']=all((ROOT/p).is_file() and (ROOT/p).stat().st_size>0 for p in required)
+    report={'integrity_checks':checks,'run_checks':runs,'video':video,
+        'scientific_convergence_flags':{k:v for k,v in summary.items() if k.endswith('_passed')},
+        'integrity_passed':all(checks.values()),
+        'integrity_does_not_imply_scientific_convergence':True}
+    (ROOT/'validation/artifact_audit.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
+    print(json.dumps(report,indent=2))
+    if not report['integrity_passed']:raise AssertionError('Artifact integrity check failed')
+
+if __name__=='__main__':main()
*** End Patch"));
